name: Dual Grid Isosurface Extraction with Stitch Cells
aliases: Crack-free Isosurface Extraction via Dual Grids and Stitch Cells
definition: A method for extracting continuous, crack-free isosurfaces from cell-centered AMR data by constructing a dual grid (connecting cell centers) to avoid dangling nodes, and filling gaps between hierarchy levels with tessellated 'stitch cells'.
summary: Dual Grid Isosurface Extraction with Stitch Cells extracts crack-free isosurfaces from cell-centered AMR data using a dual grid and tessellated stitch cells to maintain topological consistency without interpolation artifacts.
